# sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump (Resource)

Manages a MongoDB Tunnel Jump Item.

NOTE: PRA only. Requires PRA 26.1.1 or later.

Vault account jump item associations accept only MSSQL protocol tunnels on the appliance, so this type can't be associated with a vault account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage example MongoDB Tunnel Jump Item (PRA 26.1.1 or later)
resource "sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump" "example" {
  name                  = "Example MongoDB Tunnel"
  hostname              = "mongo.example.com"
  jumpoint_id           = 1
  jump_group_id         = 1
  tunnel_listen_address = "127.0.0.2"
  username              = "app_user"
  database              = "app"
}

# Authenticate against a separate database (PRA 26.3.1 or later; older
# appliances reject auth_database)
resource "sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump" "with_auth_database" {
  name          = "Example MongoDB Tunnel with auth database"
  hostname      = "mongo.example.com"
  jumpoint_id   = 1
  jump_group_id = 1
  username      = "app_user"
  database      = "app"
  auth_database = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String)
- `jump_group_id` (Number)
- `jumpoint_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `auth_database` (String) Database to authenticate against. When blank, the appliance uses `database`, then `admin`. Setting a value requires PRA 26.3.1 or later; older appliances reject the field.
- `comments` (String)
- `database` (String)
- `jump_group_type` (String)
- `jump_policy_id` (Number)
- `session_policy_id` (Number)
- `tag` (String)
- `tunnel_listen_address` (String) Local address the tunnel listens on, within 127.0.0.0/24. Defaults to 127.0.0.1. Sent to the API as `local_address`; API errors use that name.
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Item can be imported by specifying the ID
terraform import sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump.example 123
```
